tooltipBehavior.actionHintPlacement: Top with 8px gap; bottom fallback; 8px viewport clamp.
tooltipBehavior.instancePreviewPlacement: Right with 8px gap; left fallback; 8px viewport clamp.
tooltipBehavior.tracking: requestAnimationFrame follows layout, scrolling, and resizing.
dismissal: loss of hover or keyboard focus
tooltipBehavior.keyboard: Direct button focus opens hints; wrappers do not add a tab stop.
tooltipBehavior.previewLanguages: Library cards and previews share up to nine language badges, followed by the remaining count; cloud and remote instances use detected languages.
tooltipBehavior.previewMetadata: Place the 14px instance-type icon in the preview metadata row before CPU/CUDA when applicable.
tooltipBehavior.surface: Shared tooltip-bg and tooltip-border from the active theme; theme text color; no shadow for hints or rich previews.

railInstanceLayout.scrolling: List spans the rail padding; overflow-y auto; overflow-x hidden; scrollbar-gutter stable both-edges.

taskBehavior.primitive: Official Dioxus Popover; transfer rows use official Progress.
taskBehavior.scope: Session activity across instances, grouped into Active and History.
taskBehavior.history: Dismiss and Clear affect terminal records only; preserve byte counts.
taskBehavior.setup: Show actual installing/starting/updating operation status when no active byte transfer exists.
taskBehavior.ordering: Downloading/validating before queued; terminal History follows, with failed/stopped before ready.
taskBehavior.completed: Show downloaded size only; omit redundant total, 100% label, and progress bar.

statisticsBehavior.refresh: Actual local prefixed metrics endpoint every five seconds while mounted and running, plus manual Refresh; configured bearer token.
statisticsBehavior.aggregation: Requests, errors, request-weighted duration, in-flight total, and endpoint rows; no client or API-key labels.
statisticsBehavior.missing: Localized stopped/loading/connection/authorization/invalid states, not invented zero values.

translatorBehavior.entry: First and default instance tab; header Open translator returns to it.
translatorBehavior.modes: Text and Files use a compact icon-and-label mode control; shared source/target selectors.
translatorBehavior.availability: Translation controls are disabled while stopped, uninstalled, loading languages, or unable to load the server language list; localized start/install/loading/unavailable feedback.
translatorBehavior.languages: Actual running server language list, auto-detect source, supported targets.
translatorBehavior.state: Per-instance in-memory text drafts and results; edits clear old results; completed draft revisions reuse results; revision guards ignore stale responses.
translatorBehavior.request: Local URL prefix and configured API key; text format.
translatorBehavior.automatic: Translate after a 600ms typing pause; wait for input-method composition to finish; one text request at a time.
translatorBehavior.actions: Swap, Clear, Copy; character count/limit and automatic pending/error feedback.
translatorBehavior.shortViewport: At viewport heights up to 700px: panel min-height 0, panes min-height 180px, text areas min-height 140px; preserve bottom feedback.

localeBehavior.picker: Searchable twenty-choice picker with autonyms and flags; canonical regional persistence; legacy bare pt remains pt-BR, with pt-PT separate.
localeBehavior.arabic: Mirrored content/rail; left-to-right title bar/native controls and technical values; translator text direction auto.
localeBehavior.modelLanguages: Add all appends missing supported model languages without duplicates, through existing autosave.

translatorFilesBehavior.availability: Running server, instance file-translation setting, and server-reported file-translation support are required.
translatorFilesBehavior.formats: Display actual server-supported extensions; native file picker filters use those extensions.
translatorFilesBehavior.selection: Flat Workspace selection area; dashed Border stroke; 10px corners; muted file icon; chosen filename and secondary Choose file action.
translatorFilesBehavior.limits: Require a nonempty supported file up to 50MiB; show localized format/size errors.
translatorFilesBehavior.actions: Explicit green Translate file action with pending feedback; native Save translated file dialog appears after a successful result; actions wrap with a 10px gap.
translatorFilesBehavior.shortViewport: At viewport heights up to 700px: reduce selection padding and icon size to preserve file actions.

appUpdateBehavior.entry: Check stable GUI releases at startup; About provides Check for updates with inline status and a changelog action for available releases.
appUpdateBehavior.versions: Show current and available GUI versions separately from managed LibreTranslate runtime versions.
appUpdateBehavior.dialog: Optional panel with 560px width cap, viewport-bounded height, 26px padding, 15px corners, and the shared dialog shadow; green download icon and keyboard-focusable scrolling changelog.
appUpdateBehavior.direction: Mirror the current-to-new version chevron in Arabic; upstream changelog blocks and lines use automatic content direction so English notes preserve left-to-right punctuation.
appUpdateBehavior.actions: Later and the green update action align at the lower end with a 10px gap; unsupported packages disable the update action with an explanation.
appUpdateBehavior.progress: Shared thin Progress track with actual download bytes; verifying/restarting phases are indeterminate; working disables actions and dismissal.
appUpdateBehavior.completion: Verified package is staged and applied through the replacement helper, then the app reopens automatically; preserve data/preferences and roll back failed replacement.

narrative.overview:
Operate is a compact desktop utility for managing local LibreTranslate servers. Its user-approved Modrinth-inspired shell pairs a single expandable rail with a rounded workspace, neutral surfaces, and green actions. The interface gives actual readiness, configuration, and logs priority over decoration.

Dark charcoal and light neutral themes share geometry and interaction states; persisted System mode follows the operating system. The shared components support twenty interface locales: English (en), Romanian (ro), Spanish (es), French (fr), German (de), Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR), European Portuguese (pt-PT), Russian (ru), Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Arabic (ar), Hindi (hi), Hungarian (hu), Italian (it), Polish (pl), Dutch (nl), Czech (cs), Ukrainian (uk), and Greek (el). Labels must wrap cleanly and Arabic content mirrors right to left. The existing two-panel speech icon on a green tile with a lime connection remains the packaged app identity, with transparency only outside the tile.
keyCharacteristics: Compact desktop shell with one expandable rail.
Neutral tonal layering with green start/install actions, red stop controls, and green selection states.
Real process status and session tasks, direct lifecycle controls, connected work tabs, and actual local translation/statistics.
Shared Light, Dark, and System geometry across twenty locales, including mirrored Arabic content.

rules.name: The Single Shell Rule
rules.body: Keep branding in the title bar and navigation in one expandable rail; do not add a second workspace header or footer.

rules.name: The State Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Use accent and semantic colors to explain available actions, selected controls, and real process state; do not add decorative metrics or status filler.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Separate resting workspace surfaces with tone and restrained borders. Reserve shadows for select popups, dialogs, and toasts.

dos: Do preserve the compact Modrinth-inspired rail, rounded workspace, green actions, and neutral themes.
Do show real readiness, installation progress, failures, and process logs.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, explicit language names, room for translated labels, and Arabic direction handling.
Do use the official Dioxus primitives and the existing local SVG asset sets.
Do show automatic-save and validation status for existing instances, retain explicit creation/Options actions, and use toasts without moving page content.
donts: Don't add a second rail, duplicate title-bar branding, redundant workspace metadata bar, or footer.
Don't use fake metrics, decorative dashboard filler, or repeated explanatory copy.
Don't replace local interface SVG files with inline SVG or base64 icons in Rust.
Don't offer CUDA as ready merely because supported hardware was detected; device availability and runtime readiness are separate states.
Don't clip popup searches or allow floating option lists to leave the viewport.
